a: दांभिक — a. (की f.) [दंभेन चरति धर्मं-ठक्] 1 Deceitful, hypocritical. --2 Proud, imperious. --3 Ostentatious, sanctimonious. --कः 1 A cheat. --2 A hypocrite.
दांडाजिनिक — a. (की f.) Carrying a staff and hide (as mere outward signs of religious devotion). --कः A cheat, hypocrite, impostor.
दांड — a. (डी f.) Relating to a stick or punishment. --डा A kind of game with sticks.

दांत — p. p. [दम् --कर्तरि क्त] 1 Tamed, subdued, overpowered, curbed, restrained, bridled; see दम्. --2 Docile, tame, mild. --3 Self-possessed, self-controlled; U. 5. --4 Subdued, conquered, vanquished; U. 5. 33. --5 Resigned. --6 Liberal. --7 Dental. --8 Patient of bodily mortifications or austerities &c. --तः 1 A tamed ox. --2 A donor. --3 N. of a tree (दमनक).
दांतिः — f. [दम्-क्तिन्] 1 Self-restraint, subjection, control. --2 The patient endurance of bodily mortifications, religious austerities &c. --3 Humiliation.
दांतिक — a. (की f.) Made of ivory.
